BrochureContent.Content:
Hume Auctioneers - We Get The Pick Of The Crop

Enjoying perhaps the finest address in Portlaoise, Glenveigh is a beautiful detached bungalow set on a large private site within walking distance of the town centre and all amenities.
Attractively set back from the road, this charming bungalow enjoys large and front and rear gardens.

Step inside the front door and you will immediately appreciate this is a home of great charm where you will find solid qualities seldom found on the market today.

To the front of the house is a comfortable sitting room. This room enjoys a feature fireplace and great light with a large picture window overlooking the front garden. This room could double as a fourth ground floor bedroom or indeed home office.

There is a spacious living room to the rear. Once again, this room enjoys a feature fireplace and great light with a large picture window overlooking the rear garden.

This room leads to a superbly appointed Kitchen dining room which once again is flooded with natural light.

There is a most useful utility room which leads to the magnificent rear garden.

On the ground floor there are three further bedrooms, each a large double with excellent wardrobe space and flooded with natural light.

A family bathroom completes the accommodation.

A staircase leads to two further rooms on the first floor.

To the rear the garden is stunningly beautiful. Fully walled in and laid in attractive lawn with superb flower beds and mature shrubbery, the garden offers an excellent safe haven for family and pets alike.

There is a large garage and an outside toilet and a boiler room.

The entire is in pristine condition and comes to the market superbly maintained. 

No chain.

Glenveagh is within walking distance of Portlaoise town centre and all its amenities. O?Moore Park and Portlaoise Plaza are on your doorstep, with hotels, leisure centres, schools and restaurants all within walking distance.

Junction 17 of the M7/M8 motorway is just two minutes away offering immense convenience.

Viewing of this beautiful home is highly recommended.
